row.notes: cmp r13,0x10 (4 bytes) then jb rel32 to 0x1436abd80 (10-byte window; no branch lands inside) in Sess_Strategy_UpdateTeammatePairs, in the per-team loop after 0x1424abd60 returns the team car vector: r12 = vector begin, rbp = end, r13 = rbp - r12 (bytes, 8 per car record pointer), r14 = pointer to the team entry in the participant list (team id dword at [[r14]+0x28]), rsi = the session. Below 0x10 bytes the team has no pair and the code goes to 0x1436abd80. Otherwise, when the +0x81 bytes of records 0 and 1 are both set it calls the introsort 0x1436b36f0 (sorts by byte +0x80; every compare throws through Ne_Std_ThrowBadOptionalAccess when a record has +0x81 == 0), both clear it calls 0x1436b3e00, different it skips the sort. After the sort only records 0 and 1 are read (0x1436abd80). A team with a third car (garage third car in the garage crew guard) has a record with +0x81 == 0, so the sort throws as the session is entered: FatalExceptionTerminate, FAST_FAIL_INVALID_ARG (Panzerfaust_975, 1.7.16, 24 participants on 23 vehicles). Core sets rbp = r12 + 0x10 and r13 = 0x10 for a vector of more than two cars, so only the first two are sorted and paired. L1: the site is found by byte scan.
